output.markdown:
## Yellow taxi fares jumped 36.5% on MLK Day Monday 20 Jan 2025

The average total amount per yellow taxi trip on 2025-01-20 was $36.48, which was 36.5% higher than the mean of the three baseline Mondays. The baseline average total amounts were $27.63 (2025-01-06), $26.15 (2025-01-13), and $26.39 (2025-01-27). Trip count (90,094) was within normal range, and weather (zero precipitation/snow) was not a driver. The only systematic difference was that 2025-01-20 was Martin Luther King Jr. Day, a federal holiday, while the baseline Mondays were regular working days.

**Recommendation:** Investigate holiday surcharge policies or demand spikes specific to MLK Day; monitor whether the fare increase persists on non-holiday Mondays. Flag MLK Day as a key outlier in any seasonal pricing model.

### Evidence-backed claims
1. Average total amount per yellow taxi trip on 2025-01-20 was 36.5% higher than the mean of the three baseline Mondays (2025-01-06, 2025-01-13, 2025-01-27). [Q1 · sha256:a0e1ad7e7de1c62e · whybot.yellow_daily]
2. Average total amount on 2025-01-20 was $36.48. [Q1 · sha256:a0e1ad7e7de1c62e · whybot.yellow_daily]
3. Baseline average total amount on 2025-01-06 was $27.63. [Q1 · sha256:a0e1ad7e7de1c62e · whybot.yellow_daily]
4. Baseline average total amount on 2025-01-13 was $26.15. [Q1 · sha256:a0e1ad7e7de1c62e · whybot.yellow_daily]
5. Baseline average total amount on 2025-01-27 was $26.39. [Q1 · sha256:a0e1ad7e7de1c62e · whybot.yellow_daily]
6. 2025-01-20 is a federal holiday (Martin Luther King Jr. Day) while none of the baseline Mondays (2025-01-06, 2025-01-13, 2025-01-27) are federal holidays. [Q6 · sha256:5a5db8415a7a8e86 · whybot.us_holidays]
7. Precipitation and snowfall on 2025-01-20 were 0.0 mm, not materially different from the baseline Mondays. [Q7 · sha256:0da13032675b02f6 · whybot.nyc_weather_daily]
8. Average trip distance on 2025-01-20 (4.79 miles) was not materially higher than the baseline Mondays (4.40, 5.53, 4.52 miles). [Q1 · sha256:a0e1ad7e7de1c62e · whybot.yellow_daily]
9. Trip count on 2025-01-20 (90,094) was within the baseline range (80,127–100,492), so the fare jump is not a data-quality artifact. [Q1 · sha256:a0e1ad7e7de1c62e · whybot.yellow_daily]

### Caveats
- Temperature was colder on 2025-01-20 (tmax -3.2°C, tmin -8.2°C) than all baseline Mondays, but H2 was refuted because it focused on precip/snow; cold could be a secondary factor not tested here.
- Data quality (not evidence): the TPCDS date_dim.d_holiday flag disagrees with Nager.Date on 3 date(s): 2024-12-31: TPCDS date_dim.d_holiday=Y but Nager.Date says no national holiday; 2025-01-20: d_holiday=N, Nager.Date: Martin Luther King, Jr. Day (national holiday); 2025-02-17: d_holiday=N, Nager.Date: Presidents Day (national holiday). Holidays come from Nager.Date only [DQ1 sha256:8441c7c602666af3].

hypotheses.refute_if: avg_trip_distance and trip count on 2025-01-20 are in line with baseline Mondays.
